نرض (form I)
# نَرُضُّ (naruḍḍu) /na.rudˤ.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of رَضَّ (raḍḍa)
# نُرَضُّ (nuraḍḍu) /nu.radˤ.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of رَضَّ (raḍḍa)
# نَرُضَّ (naruḍḍa) /na.rudˤ.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَضَّ (raḍḍa)
# نُرَضَّ (nuraḍḍa) /nu.radˤ.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunct
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
